subject: Field Lab: Hybrid demo booth + joint webinar — logistics & MDF request

Subject: Field Lab: Hybrid demo booth + joint webinar — logistics & MDF request

Hi Sylvia,

Great to meet at the edge summit last week — thanks again for the quick sync. We discussed a hybrid "Field Lab" concept (on-site demo booth at your EdgeWorks Summit + a follow-up technical webinar) and I wanted to put a proposed ops and funding outline on your radar. Short version: Redwood runs a 4-hour booth/demo on-site (4 staff total, rotating), EdgeWorks hosts a 60-minute deep-dive webinar the week after. We split MDF 60/40 (EdgeWorks/Redwood) to cover booth build, shipping, and creative.

Key asks:
- Can EdgeWorks confirm booth footprint (we're planning a 10x20 shell) and power/WiFi SLA?
- Can you share lead capture integration details (HubSpot stage and fields) so we can wire our badge scanner?
- Are you comfortable with Redwood running a short live inference demo that uses a masked dataset (no customer data)? We will provide a compliance blurb.

I've attached a rough booth layout and a draft webinar agenda for review. If this looks sensible I'd like to request a formal MDF submission and lock speakers + rehearsal slots.

Proposed timeline:
- Dec 6: confirm MDF and booth footprint
- Dec 10: dry-run + joint speaker rehearsal (30 mins)
- Dec 14: on-site activation at EdgeWorks Summit
- Dec 21: webinar (60 minutes)

If you're ok with the 60/40 split, I can submit the MDF packet via the link you provide by EOD Dec 1.

Thanks — Ben

--

Hey Ben — thanks for the clear plan. EdgeWorks is interested. Quick answers:
- Booth: 10x20 confirmed, corner shell. We'll provide 110V power and managed WiFi with <30ms latency on the event LAN for demo VLANs — ops will send a network diagram.
- HubSpot: we can share an integration template; we use HubSpot portal HS-98342. You can post leads to our portal via the connector; Jonathan will follow up with the exact fields.
- Data/compliance: masked demo is fine. We prefer the demo run inside a sandbox environment; please include the compliance blurb in the MDF packet.

MDF: EdgeWorks is prepared to cover 40% of booth cost and 50% of webinar paid promotion if Redwood fronts 60% booth and production. Partners@marketmesh.com will need the MDF submission by Dec 3 to approve fund release.

Can you send a budget line itemization (booth build, shipping, AV, labor) and speaker bios? We'll also need an attendee conversion metric target so finance can size the co-investment.

Best,
Sylvia

Ben / Grace,

- Booth build + drayage: $8,400
- AV (2x screens, sound, one stage mic): $2,300
- Shipping and crating: $1,200
- On-site labor (4 staff, 8 hrs): $1,600
- Webinar production (platform + streaming + editor): $2,200
- Paid promotion (EdgeWorks share): $1,500 (we'd ask them to co-fund)

Total Redwood gross: $15,700. With the proposed 60/40 split (Redwood fronting 60% booth + production) our requested MDF from EdgeWorks would be $6,280. If they cover 50% of webinar promotion that's an additional $750 credit.

Notes:
- We should request a HubSpot shared list access for the event window (48 hrs) rather than only connector posts to avoid lead lag.
- Need legal to sign a short co-marketing A&R before any funds move — Marissa, can you kick off that ticket?
